title: Music service chips: accessible name matches the visible text (axe label-content-name-mismatch)
acceptance: Each Music › service chip (for example "SoundCloud, Connected") has an accessible name that contains its visible text in the same order, so axe label-content-name-mismatch (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name) no longer fires on Music.
The 'Music songs' entry is removed from KNOWN_AXE in e2e/smoke.spec.ts and the smoke stays green at 1440 and 390 wide.

evidence.summary: Local e2e smoke on the RF-151 branch: label-content-name-mismatch (serious) on button[aria-label="SoundCloud, Connected"], "Spotify, Catalog only" and "Apple Music, Catalog only". Recorded as known for 'Music songs'.
Owner pre-approved RF-173 for the 2026-11-05 unattended Neo session.

Neo local: with the 'Music songs' KNOWN_AXE entry removed, the smoke failed on main code (label-content-name-mismatch on all three chips, e.g. button[aria-label="SoundCloud, Connected"]) and passed (2/2 at 1440 and 390) with the fix. Dashboard.test.tsx 218 tests passed (chip names unchanged).

resolution: axe joins a control's child text without spaces, so the chip's visible text read as "soundcloudcatalog only", which the aria-label "SoundCloud, Catalog only" does not contain. A space text node between the service name and the state mark (not rendered inside the flex chip) makes the visible text two words that the aria-label contains; the 'Music songs' KNOWN_AXE entry is removed and the smoke stays green at 1440 and 390. The accessible name is unchanged.
